📱 Open ProfRev properly

This screen is a file preview (from WhatsApp, Files or Mail), which shows the page but does not run apps, so ProfRev cannot start here.

On iPhone or iPad: open your ProfRev link from claude.ai in Safari, then Share → Add to Home Screen. To use it offline on a phone, follow step 3 in the README (one-time upload to Netlify).

On a laptop: unzip the folder and double-click Open ProfRev (or open index.html in Chrome, Edge or Safari).
